Authorities Enhance Security Measures for Kanwar Yatra Across Multiple Cities

Authorities in Ghaziabad, Saharanpur, Modinagar, and Panipat are implementing extensive security arrangements for the upcoming Kanwar Yatra. Ghaziabad has established six control rooms and helpline numbers, with police deployed across 72 points in three shifts. Saharanpur will utilize 3,000 CCTV cameras, including night-vision cameras, for 24-hour monitoring from a new control room. Modinagar has divided its area into eight sectors, deploying 35 police personnel per kilometer. Efforts are also being made to improve lighting at dark spots along Kanwar routes.
